correctness.rationale: The orientation/clique-order/gap bijection is exact for every integer r>=2, s>=1. A cover edge is either a clique-consecutive edge when its intervening gap is empty, or a one/two-sided independent vertex cover edge. This proves the degree formula and coefficient extraction. The excess is sum max(c_i-1,0), giving the exact simple criterion and multiplicity. Moving simple states to the all-left gap and permuting clique vertices proves induced connectivity. Direct edge-orientation census and separate gap-state BFS passed for all stated small parameters; finite checks are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Primary full texts distinguish global graphical-zonotope f-polynomial and global simplicity classification from the claimed per-vertex degree distribution and connectivity of the simple-vertex induced graph. Targeted published-finding corpus queries and published-literature searches yielded no covering exact formula for complete-split graphical zonotopes. value.rationale: The incidence degree distribution and the connectedness of the simple-vertex locus are natural local geometric invariants of a nontrivial two-parameter family of graphical zonotopes. The classification pinpoints exactly which gap crowding creates nonsimplicity, and supplies constructive paths among all simple vertices; neither follows from total face enumeration. The distinction between globally nonsimple polytopes and connected simple strata provides mathematically motivated structural content, not an arbitrary finite slice.
